codes.title: Settings file .env is missing
causes: The admin-site\.env file was never created
It was renamed or deleted
fix: In the admin-site folder copy .env.example to a new file named .env
Fill in DB_SERVER, DB_AUTH, DB_DRIVER and SESSION_SECRET (see admin-site README)
Run npm run doctor to confirm, then start the site again
codes.log: logs/runtime/admin-YYYY-MM-DD.log (search for the code or the reference number); screen

codes.title: SESSION_SECRET is missing or too weak
causes: SESSION_SECRET is empty, still 'change-this…', or shorter than 32 characters
fix: Open admin-site\.env
Set SESSION_SECRET to a random phrase of at least 32 characters (npm run doctor -- --new-secret prints one)
Save and start the site again; everyone must sign in again
codes.log: logs/runtime/admin-YYYY-MM-DD.log (search for the code or the reference number); screen
codes.user: SESSION_SECRET is missing or too weak

codes.title: Site opened to the network without HTTPS cookies
causes: HOST is not 127.0.0.1/localhost but COOKIE_SECURE is not 1
fix: Keep HOST=127.0.0.1 for local use (recommended)
Only when hosting behind HTTPS: set COOKIE_SECURE=1 and TRUST_PROXY=1
codes.log: logs/runtime/admin-YYYY-MM-DD.log (search for the code or the reference number); screen
codes.user: Site opened to the network without HTTPS cookies

codes.title: Node.js version is too old
causes: Node.js older than version 18 is installed
fix: Download the LTS version from https://nodejs.org and install it
Close and reopen the command window, then run node --version
codes.log: logs/runtime/doctor-YYYY-MM-DD.log and the doctor screen

codes.title: demo-sites folder not found
codes.where: Admin site: Save to demo-sites folder
causes: admin-site was moved away from the repository folder
DEMO_SITES_DIR points to a folder that does not exist
fix: Keep admin-site inside skytech-agent-program next to demo-sites
Or set DEMO_SITES_DIR in .env to the full path of the demo-sites folder
codes.log: logs/runtime/admin-YYYY-MM-DD.log (search for the code or the reference number)

codes.title: Port already in use
causes: The Admin site is already running in another window

fix: Close the other black Admin site window, or
Set PORT=3031 in .env and open http://127.0.0.1:3031

codes.title: Required package missing
causes: npm install was not run, or node_modules was deleted
fix: Open a Command Prompt in admin-site and run npm install
Run npm run doctor

codes.title: Cannot connect to SQL Server
causes: The SQL Server service is stopped
DB_SERVER does not match the server name used in SSMS
Firewall or instance name wrong (e.g. localhost\SQL2014)
fix: Press Windows key → Services → 'SQL Server (…)' → Start
Open SSMS, copy the exact Server name into DB_SERVER in .env
Run npm run doctor; if it still fails, try npm run demo to confirm the site itself works
codes.log: logs/runtime/admin-YYYY-MM-DD.log (search for the code or the reference number); logs/runtime/doctor-YYYY-MM-DD.log and the doctor screen

codes.title: Windows login needs the msnodesqlv8 package
causes: msnodesqlv8 failed to install (it only installs on Windows)
fix: On the Windows PC run npm install in admin-site
If it still fails, install 'Visual C++ Redistributable', or use DB_AUTH=sql with a SQL login (see sql/06)
codes.log: logs/runtime/admin-YYYY-MM-DD.log (search for the code or the reference number)
codes.user: Windows login needs the msnodesqlv8 package

codes.title: ODBC driver not found
causes: DB_DRIVER names a driver that is not installed
fix: Windows key → 'ODBC Data Sources (64-bit)' → Drivers tab
Copy an installed name (e.g. 'SQL Server Native Client 11.0' or 'ODBC Driver 17 for SQL Server') into DB_DRIVER
codes.log: logs/runtime/admin-YYYY-MM-DD.log (search for the code or the reference number)

codes.title: SQL login failed
causes: DB_USER or DB_PASSWORD wrong
SQL Server authentication (mixed mode) is turned off
The login is disabled or its password expired
fix: Check DB_USER / DB_PASSWORD in .env
In SSMS: server Properties → Security → 'SQL Server and Windows Authentication mode', restart the service
Or switch to DB_AUTH=windows
codes.log: logs/runtime/admin-YYYY-MM-DD.log (search for the code or the reference number)

codes.title: Database request timed out
causes: SQL Server is busy or a long query is blocking
Very large table without index
fix: Wait and retry
In SSMS run: EXEC sp_who2 to look for blocking sessions
Restart the SQL Server service if it stays stuck
codes.log: logs/runtime/admin-YYYY-MM-DD.log (search for the code or the reference number)

codes.title: Permission denied in the database
causes: The app connects with a restricted login that lacks a permission
sql/06 role was created before a new table existed
fix: Re-run sql/06_security_and_logging.sql (re-grants all permissions to SkyTechApp)
Make sure the app's login is a member of the SkyTechApp role
codes.log: logs/runtime/admin-YYYY-MM-DD.log (search for the code or the reference number)

codes.title: Unexpected database error
causes: An error not covered by other codes
fix: Note the reference number shown on screen
Search the admin log for that reference to read the SQL error number and message
Look the SQL error number up in this guide or send it to SkyTech_Manager
codes.log: logs/runtime/admin-YYYY-MM-DD.log (search for the code or the reference number); dbo.ErrorLog in SkyTechCRM (SELECT TOP 50 * FROM dbo.ErrorLog ORDER BY ErrorLogID DESC)

codes.title: Database errors were recorded in dbo.ErrorLog
codes.where: npm run doctor; any stored procedure
causes: A stored procedure failed (import, merge, fix, backup) and wrote its error to dbo.ErrorLog before rolling back
fix: In SSMS run: SELECT TOP 20 * FROM SkyTechCRM.dbo.ErrorLog ORDER BY ErrorLogID DESC
Look up the ErrorNumber in the Troubleshooting Guide table "SQL Server error numbers"
After fixing, old rows can be removed with EXEC dbo.usp_PurgeErrorLog @KeepDays = 90
codes.log: dbo.ErrorLog (database)
